structuralDecisions.decision: Keep all new line-tool code (toolStarted/draftPoints state, the LEFT_CLICK handler, pickLandPoint, addDraftPointEntity, addDraftLineEntity, clearDraftEntities, and the SaturdayMetadata type) inside ReagentMapView.vue. No new file, module, composable, or package is created.
structuralDecisions.rationale: Extends the exact pattern reagent-map-expeditions already established in this file (addSiteEntities/addExpeditionEntities/flyToSite as plain functions over module-scope viewer/cesium/ellipsoid). This app has no Vitest/unit-test runner — only Playwright and Cucumber — so extracting pickLandPoint into a separately-testable module would buy no real testability without adding new test infrastructure, which this order does not request. Analyst flagged uncertainty about where click-to-geo-point logic should live; resolving that now: it lives beside the other per-entity helpers.
tradeOffs: pickLandPoint's two rejection paths (AC9/AC10) are only exercised through Playwright + real WebGL, not fast unit tests
ReagentMapView.vue grows from ~220 lines to roughly 320-350 — still well short of anything requiring a split, but a third interactive tool should trigger re-evaluation (see Refactoring Opportunities)

structuralDecisions.decision: Introduce one shared type, SaturdayMetadata = { id: string; name: string; kind: 'site' | 'expedition' | 'draft-point' | 'draft-line' }, in ReagentMapView.vue and use it at all four tagging call sites (addSiteEntities, addExpeditionEntities, addDraftPointEntity, addDraftLineEntity) in place of the existing `(entity as unknown as { saturdayMetadata: unknown })` cast's untyped literal.
structuralDecisions.rationale: architecture-guardrails.md #4 forbids raw `any`; the existing cast already correctly routes through `unknown`, but the `kind` string literals are not checked against each other today. reagent-map-expeditions already accepted duplicating this cast once (its architecture-notes.md deferred the extraction as 'not justified by this order alone'); this order adds a third and fourth call site with two more kind values, which is the point design-principles.md's 'No Duplication' rule intends to catch.
tradeOffs: One more type to extend the day a fifth entity kind (e.g. a future polygon tool) arrives
Still routes through a cast at the assignment point, since Cesium's own Entity type has no saturdayMetadata field — this narrows what can be assigned, it doesn't remove the cast

fitness.verification: code-reviewer confirms by diff review — no ESLint config exists anywhere in this repo yet, so this is manual judgment, not an automated gate

structuralDecisions.decision: Resolve a screen click to a geographic point with a single pickLandPoint(position) function using Cesium's native camera.pickEllipsoid followed by `new EllipsoidalOccluder(ellipsoid, camera.positionWC).isPointVisible(...)`, written as two independent guard clauses (off-globe, far-side) returning GeoPoint | null. No Strategy class, no Adapter, no custom geometry math.
structuralDecisions.rationale: ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md's guard-clause convention and Simple Design Rule #4 (fewest elements) apply directly: AC9 and AC10 are two sequential, independent rejection checks, not branches of one conditional on a type code, so Decompose Conditional / Replace Conditional with Polymorphism don't apply here. Using Cesium's own occluder avoids reinventing visibility math.

structuralDecisions.decision: Draft state (toolStarted, draftPoints, draftEntities) stays as component-local Vue refs/plain arrays in ReagentMapView.vue. It is not promoted to a Pinia store.
structuralDecisions.rationale: Identical lifecycle to the existing sites/expeditions/viewer state: ephemeral, scoped to one view instance, with exactly one consumer. The spec explicitly defers persistence to reagent-map-save; promoting to a store now would be premature generalization (design-principles.md Anti-Pattern Radar) for a requirement this order doesn't have.
tradeOffs: reagent-map-save will need to re-decide this once a Save action needs to read the draft from a different place in the tree — this decision doesn't block that, it just doesn't do it preemptively

structuralDecisions.decision: Import GeoPoint from ../api/expeditions.ts in ReagentMapView.vue rather than declaring a second { lat, lng } type for draft points.
structuralDecisions.rationale: design-principles.md's No Duplication rule, and it keeps the draft-point shape identical to Expedition.from/to — the same shape reagent-map-save's SaveExpedition call will need next, so no translation layer is required between the draft and the eventual save payload; both live in the same bounded context (Expedition Planning).

structuralDecisions.decision: Register the LEFT_CLICK handler exactly once, via viewer.screenSpaceEventHandler.setInputAction(...), inside onMounted's happy path alongside the rest of viewer setup. startLine() never registers or re-registers a handler. No new teardown code is added to onBeforeUnmount.
structuralDecisions.rationale: Cesium's ScreenSpaceEventHandler is itself Observer/PubSub (ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md section III); using it directly avoids a custom event system. The Viewer owns and destroys its own ScreenSpaceEventHandler when viewer.destroy() runs, so the existing onBeforeUnmount cleanup already covers it — no new resource to release.
